$comment: Page discovery (Phase 2). heuristicPaths are probed on the brand's origin; sitemap URLs are kept only when their path (locale prefix removed) contains one of sitemapKeywords. Higher keyword weight = fetched earlier. Limits bound the work done per brand. sustainabilityKeywords decide which pages count as sustainability-type pages. ranking: each path segment beyond the first costs depthPenalty points, and at most maxPerSection URLs are kept under one first path segment (e.g. /stories/...), so a blog cannot crowd out the brand's own policy pages. nonDurableIndustries (Phase 5, axis E): Wikidata P452 industry labels (lowercase, exact) of brands whose products are consumed rather than kept (food, drink); for them the repair axis is 'not applicable', not scored, and listed under 'What we could not check'. An unknown industry counts as durable, so repair information is looked for. Phase 14 (QA-3, builder decision for the director): widened to energy and utilities, transport, finance, telecoms, services, retail, fashion and similar industries whose products or services are not kept and repaired by the customer, so a fetch gap is not scored as 'no repair information' (brief Section 4). Durable-goods industries (electronics, appliances, furniture, vehicles, tools, outdoor gear) stay applicable.
